title: How Long Does It Take to Build a Website in the UK? (2026)
meta_title: How Long Does It Take to Build a Website? (UK, 2026)
meta_description: A small UK business website takes 1–4 weeks with a fixed package and 6–12 weeks with an agency. Timelines by type and how to launch faster.
keywords: how long does it take to build a website
how long to make a website for small business

faq.q: How long does a small business website take to build?
faq.a: A simple 5 to 7 page site usually takes 1 to 2 weeks once content is ready. Larger business sites take 2 to 4 weeks.

faq.q: Why do website projects take longer than expected?
faq.a: Most delays come from missing content (text, photos, prices) and slow feedback, not the build itself.

faq.q: How long does an online shop take to build?
faq.a: A small shop with up to 100 products usually takes 2 to 4 weeks, depending on how ready the product photos and descriptions are.

faq.q: Can a website be built in a week?
faq.a: Yes, a simple site can launch in about a week if the content and feedback are ready.

faq.q: How long do agencies take to build a website?
faq.a: Custom agency builds typically take 6 to 12 weeks, including discovery, design rounds and testing.
